items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I played with them in that band. My sister played drum and then Sal played drum.

ctx.x: I played with them. Like Betty Hutton.
I played with them in that band. My sister played drum and then Sal played drum. My sister, Lice Perry, Lice Bajon.
I was the only guy in the band with eight women in the family. A lot of music in the family.
